top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength principle resolved the decisive trapping-shift problem and has produced independently reproducible optical lattice clocks: a mature, precisely bounded physical capability. Katori and Ye remain the most defensible compact attribution when the citation is confined to the principle and defining realization.
recusal_note: No recusal-triggering connection is apparent. My documented collaborations in attosecond physics do not involve the proposed laureates or the preferred achievement.
